LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 LANGUAGE PATTERN: USE OF TOO...TO/FOR AND USE OF MUST/SHOULD WITH AN ADVERB/ADVERBIAL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern: Use of too...to/for and Use of Must/Should with an Adverb/Adverbial

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern: Use of too...to/for and Use of Must/Should with an Adverb/Adverbial, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do you identify correct sentences? 2. Why is it important to use sentences correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Language Pattern: Use of too...to/for and Use of Must/Should with an Adverb/Adverbial together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
